headline: Paramount agrees to delay Warner Bros. merger amid claims of antitrust violations
summary: Jul. 24—OLYMPIA — The Paramount Skydance planned merger with Warner Bros. has been halted as a federal judge considers whether the deal violates antitrust laws and unfairly reduces market competition.
